data: Definitely worth the money and I highly recommend
The gameplay is simple and fun, the soundtrack is amazing, the multiplayer is phenomenal, the DLCs are all a blast and absolutely worth their value
Very good game really fun, worth the price with tons of content
Very good game for it's price and well worth it very fun with different characters and maps
Overall, it's a super fun and addicting game and I look forward to the future content patches and releases for this game
This is the reason I don't recommend spending time and money on the game

In this game, the Garlic weapon is clearly the best, and possibly the strongest weapon in the game. This is a clear reference to the fact that the player base of Vampire Survivors emits the scent of garlic in real life

I found this game when i was like 11 and 3 years after i got back to the game and now am 100% it. It is just pure peak. It is a cheap game with simple and adicting gameplay. This game finaly got me to the world of roguelikes/roguelites. 10/10 game for me. And the developers are cooking with the updates and DLCs.
10/10 Outstanding game. Enjoyed every second of the base game and cannot wait to sink an ungodly amount of hours into the DLC's

For the price point, it's an incredible diversion. Most runs are nice and quick, the game is decently well designed, and they're doing a solid job of increasing the quality and depth with each patch in interesting ways. Some of the mechanics aren't explained exceptionally well but are easy enough to figure out with some experimentation and a bit of research. Absolutely worth it.

I write this review right after the Ante Chamber came out, a free DLC with new characters weapons and map to play on, and not only that finally an online co op mode, I am happy to see a game where the devs keep adding stuff even after 3 years, beside that I bought the game with all of the DLC not knowing how addicted I would get and sure did I become to this game, I almost have 40 hours in this game, I played only this game for the past couple days, and all this time I didn't even finish the base game. is it boring? no, it's not, I am sure gonna have 100+ hours in this game and still have a lot of stuff to do but it's the first time it won't feel like a waste of time.

Highly recommend this game if you like a good grind in games, the payout for learning new combos and enduring the annoyance of every defeat just makes every victory so worth while. The simplicity of the style paired with the amazing soundtrack and beautiful maps makes every new round fresh and fun.

The nest 3 dollars I ever spent. Don't let the Early Access tag fool you, there's a TON of content in the game even now. If you're at all on the fence about this, I'd highly suggest looking up a gameplay video: that's what I did, and actually seeing the game in motion is what tipped me over to actually buy it.
Pretty easy and fun once you get the hang of the movement and weapon combos

I love to play this game when my mom calls. Not too complicated to distract me from the conversation, and keeps me sane while she repeats the same stories she told during last week's call.

I love her, but she is getting old and forgetful.

A surprisingly fun game. It has a simple game loop of learning how to get stronger. This game shows that graphics aren't everything.

I got the base game for free on another platform and decided to buy game + all dlc on sale for Steam.
Just a very very fun roguelite. The game puts you in 'the zone' and rhythm - thereafter it's you vs the horde, survive or die, thats it, simple yet wonderfully fun.

This is the probably the only game that I have ever played that feels like it is a game made by a gamer to gamers. It is beautiful, fun, addicting but safe (mostly). It will feel like your favorite game, especially if you played during the 90s.

When I first watched a friend of mine play this, I have to admit it looked a little lack-luster considering the only gameplay controls are movement and select your upgrades. But after watching a few more runs I began to understand...

This game has a very large pool of items , characters, maps, gameplay modifiers and secrets to unlock and play with. Like any good roguelike it allows you to mix and match combinations to make each run unique. I was impressed by the amount of content you get for only £7.17 (including DLCs). Every handful of runs I would unlock a new gameplay element that allows me to change the game even more. This game feeds that itch that is scratched by games like Risk of Rain 2 and has that same "just one more run" feeling to it. I have on more than one occasion sat down to play a single run and ended up playing 4 or more... And even after getting all of the achievements and playing for 60 hours I still feel like I have not seen all the content this game has to offer. I know i haven't unlocked all the characters yet.

TL;DR :

basic gameplay
fast, chaotic and fun
lots of content
good price
much replay-ability
fun, non-grindy achievements
great on Steam Deck (might make u lag :) )
VERY addictive
no vampires (yet?)

If you enjoy the rogue-like/lite genre you will enjoy this game!
Highly recommend!

A simple game, far more entertaining than any description would let on. The most reliably satisfying way to kill time in 30 minute chunks.

The game is alive, I've finished all the content several times with an update always right around the corner to send me achievement hunting again.

Love this game so much. Perfect way to waste some time and have fun all the while.
Especially great if you're short on time and just wanna get a little bit of gaming in on the steamdeck

Absolutely amazing how addicting a game who's only real controls are directions, other than button selections outside of combat. Can be an absolute blast to waste a couple of hours or a massive time sink reading into lore, descriptions, achievement hunting and dlc that's genuinely worth their price. Easy to get your money's worth, yet equally easy to lose ridiculous hours into it. Perfect execution for such a simple concept.
All my friends at work make fun of me for playing this game. I dont care what they say. They are going to Hell. This is the best game ever.

Vampire Survivors looks simple at first glance, but rest assured it's a deep rabbit hole and you'll wonder more than once what's happening right now.

11/10 <3

Soundtrack is amazing, too. Please make the hyper and forsaken versions available, pretty please ! Forsaken Sole Solution is *chef's kiss*, just like the Queen herself!
very fun game i plan to spend the rest of my life playing it. i would recommend to people that have more than 10 inches.

The game that keeps on giving.

What started as an interesting little game to play for a very small amount of money has inspired countless imitators that want a piece of the pie.

Vampire Survivors has survived all the imitations and keeps surpassing them with added new content. It was just something to play for a few rounds now and then. Here I am, always topping up my achievements to 100% whenever they add new ones, increasing the time played bit by bit.

You want entertainment value for your money? This could be it. Just give it a shot.

Edit: The Ode to Castlevania DLC just brings this full circle. For a Castlevania fan this is now basically a must. Grab it, get the DLC, spend countless hours of your life playing this.

If you ever thought that you have too much time, try playing this and you end up with none.
Surprisingly deep and fun game.
The best parts are its replayability and amazing difficulty customization.

This game is charmingly simple and addicting. It's kind of fascinating how different each session can feel when you can only directly control your character's movement. It's good fun to make a cool build with what the game throws at you, then relax and look at the pretty lights while everything blows up.

9/10 - Amazing

I heard about this game many many times, but watching streams and screenshots of it actually discouraged me from playing for some reason.
So I finally gave in and wanted to see what all the hype was about. I was pleasantly surprised, to say the least.
I don't remember the last time I wanted to witness every single detail a game has to offer this badly.

Don't judge the book by its cover.
I enthusiastically suggest anyone who's into rogue-lites to give this game a fair shot.

After getting all 140 achievements, I can wholeheartedly say that this game is like nothing I've ever played. Upon first playing it, a single 30 minute run soon snowballed into five whole hours of playing. If you're a fan of games that occupy your thumbs, I highly suggest picking up Vampire Survivors. Regardless, it's $5, so even if you're unhappy, it's not that expensive.

11/10

This has to be one of the best values in gaming history for only $5. I am currently at 71 hours at the time of writing and am showing no signs of slowing down. The replayability is through the roof. There are a ton of characters, items, weapons, stages and secrets to find and unlock. The ability to use a different "build" almost every run makes the game constantly feel fresh. One of the my favorite games of 2022 and definitely should have been a nominee for GOTY in my opinion!

Great Rouge-lite. A friend of mine introduced this to me on the switch, one of the most unique and entertaining games I've played in a long. 

Music: 10/10
Gameplay: 9/10
Replayability: 10/10
Silly game references: 11/10

Total: 10/10
This game is like an orgasm. It builds up nicely then just explodes with amazing euphoria once you max out weapons in a run. It makes me shaky <3 I love it.

Completed all the achievements and got almost a hundred of hours worth of fun just with the main game (I have yet to involve into the Among US collab DLC and Adventure mode). Play it without guides, at your own pace, learn to do afk builds if you are a completionist, try builds, characters, the game gives you enough clues through unlocks to guide you and get the most of it. 100% recommended. Worth every single cent. We need more games like this where mechanics, an epic sound track and fun are the core of the game. Just a heads up, it gets very flashy sometimes with the VFX when you have the most visually noisy weapons as a full loadout but the game has the options to disable it. A must have for anyone seeking fun and for people wanting to have a small sessions game to play during downtime at work is fantastic.

Great game. Works great on the Steam Decc straight out the bot. Very addictive straight out the box as well. With the gameplay so minimalistic its easy to jump into at any time. Play for just a few minutes or binge play it through the day. The achievements encourage you to try out different aspects of the game. Tons of ways to upgrade your character and play in so many ways. Even after completing 100% achievements it still draws me in to play more. With so many characters and options, it makes it easy to challenge friends with different ways to play.

The game is not high graphics demanding so you should be able to easily play the game on pretty much most system. But I do warn you it can start to get really colorful really fast.

TLDR
This game is incredible and one of the best in its genre.

Summary
Although its not the first of its kind, it certainly is the one which gave the genre a huge boost.
It is still one of the best 'enemy hell' games out there, even though there are now many clones.

Pros

Very low price (I got this for €3,99).
You can easily get dozens of hours of fun out of this game.
The controls are very simple. So, even people with accessibility needs may be able to play this game.
Huge amount of achievements.
More selectable/varied characters than other games in this genre.
More maps than most other games in this genre.
The maps are far more interesting than other games in this genre. The maps are not all simply infinitely repeating.
There are 'goals' to get to and things to find in the different maps. So, not just aimlessly wandering around.

Cons

Once you get a lot of upgrades, the sessions take too long.
Fun and easy to play, difficult enough to want to keep trying but not so hard you have to sweat really hard. Great music with fun levels and enemies, great game for a fair price.
Totally worth the price. Multiplayer is fun. Gameloop is fun. And my brain is turned off. Love it!

Spent a couple fun hours with Vampire Survivors today and I have to say that it is a blast. This game brings me back to my younger days on Atari systems and also going to the Arcade. It's a great little gem that is one of those games that is simple to learn but hard to master. In my two hours of playing I only have managed to get a character to level 25 so far before getting myself surrounded. I love the graphics, the way the game plays, heck I even like the music which I hardly ever leave game music on. All in all I give this game a 10/10.

For $3 USD this is a MUST HAVE game. Pass up that Coffee this morning and buy this game instead.

I played this game for 10 hours and then got distracted with another game. Coming back to this game a second time and I'm having more fun the second time around. Learning which weapons are good early vs late game will change the way you play and make the game go the full 30 minutes per level.

Let me say it like this: If I was a PC operating system engineer, I'd put Vampire Survivors and FTL in the games that come pre-installed with my operating system. Incredible game. Worth a try if you started playing videogames in the 80s - 90s.

This game is really enjoyable if you are looking for a nice power fantasy. The infinite scaling of combat, aesthetics, and numerous ways to build your character allows for a lot of replayability. The developers, as of this review, are also constantly adding new (and cheap) content.

Vampire Survivors starts off with a simple yet incredibly addictive gameplay loop, it's super fun watching your power increase as your unlock new weapons, synergies and characters. The game packs in loads of content in the form of weapons, passives, maps and characters and is an absolute steal for 3.99.

This game has the uncanny ability to fast forward you through 30 minutes of time in the blink of an eye, it's a great little time waster. The end game however feels like a bit of a slog (especially when I went for all achievements) and you essentially get to a point where you're so powerful the game plays itself which is a bit silly.

Finally, an awesome game made in Italy and by an Italian developer!
Truth be told, my country can't really make good video games, they mostly su.ck, so I was stunned to learn this was created by an italian.

Vampire Survivors has carved out a new genre and is incredibly addictive. It deserves all the praise it’s getting.
The developer and his team are constantly providing free content updates as well as both free and paid DLCs (fairly priced), plus amazing collaborations with Konami’s Castlevania, Balatro’s team, and more to come.

What else is there to say?
It’s awesome and a lot of fun. Forget all the copycats and lookalike games trying to steal its success—Vampire Survivors is the original, and the one and only.

This game is amazingly addictive. Auto-fire weapons deal with the hordes of enemies as you try and survive and gain power-ups long enough to take some gold out and buy new characters. Rogue-like abilities/power-ups and tons of unlocks. Some characters and weapons are loosely based on the Castlevania series enough to pay some homage to the the games. Worth every penny of the $2.99 price.
I love it, I mean its just two levels now, but the gameplay is there. More levels, more combo weapons and its a banger. For that price especially.

Besides starting the bullet heaven trend, this game is a shining example of what a single developer can achieve. The game is ridiculously cheap for the amount of content it has, and new content is added pretty often in the form of free updates and paid DLCs.

Speaking of DLCs, I can't recommend them enough, they are a great way to support the developer, and the content is amazing. As of writing this review, there are two DLCs currently available, and a new one in development. Both of them includes new characters, weapons, achievements and maps, they are great additions but none of them feel mandatory to enjoy the game.

This game deserves all the praise it gets. I consider Vampire Survivors a must play.

The song that plays when you get a treasure chest is half of the reward for getting a treasure chest.

(This game is *absolutely* worth the price they're asking for it. Get it if you like simple little games that are addicting.)

VERY addicting title with tons and tons of secrets to discover, with ton and ton of replayability
As an italian I also love the tons of jokes that only us from the big shoe can understand (do not google what the evolution of the holy water weapon is called.)
Not suggested to people with epilepsy, the typical lategame gameplay looks like a modern art piece in constant movement

Fun gameplay loop. Still feels like it is on its way and building in a good creative way. I would love more options for something to do with gold. Item passive buffs for damage, duration, etc. could be a goldyhole and still reward for holding out for an item. The new characters are fun to play and gatti build for life. Worth investing in.

So many updates later and the game is swimming with additional changes. I don't see any hope they are going to stop and I love it.

I dont get the reason behind this games popularity , it feels like an old browser game from 2010s and if you think about it , the gameplay itself is couldnt be more simple , since you are basically just walking around the map while dodging monsters.
The thing that i cant withsdant is that ; i want to be the one who is doing do work , i want to be the guy who uses in game materials to kill monsters , in this game the axe that flows from your ass is more main character than you are .
Still iam going to give a thumbs up because considering its price , two hours i have spend in game was fun but i hardly find any encourage to keep going .

Do I own this on multiple platforms? Yes have I beaten it on multiple platforms? Of course will I be playing the steam version to completion? Heck yeah to say this game is the best bang for your buck is a absolute understatement it is the best 5 dollars you will ever spend and you can get it and it's dlc for under 20 most of the time
This game is kind of brainless and yet VERY engrossing? Chill but timed? Honestly, it's sort of a contradiction, but I'm enjoying the heck out of it.
for a game that at a glance seems so simple in every regard, there's an absurd amount of depth

Simplicity itself. Run around for 30mins and try to survive. Near endless replay value with crazy builds to experiment with, a ridiculously large character roster to unlock, extra stages to unlock and play on and rogue lite elements to upgrade between games to increase your chances on future forays against the hordes. The Castlevania inspiration is a bit on the nose but only adds to the charm if you're a fan
